title: A word of encouragement for this week.
author: LPC Pastoral Team
body:
Christ helps you win the daily battles of the mind by shifting your focus from anxiety to truth. He empowers you to take negative thoughts captive, replaces fear with peace, and equips you with His own perspective to overcome mental strongholds.

"The weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh but have divine power to demolish strongholds... taking every thought captive to obey Christ." 
— 2 Corinthians 10:4-5

The Thought: "When a doubtful or fearful thought enters, I don't have to believe it. I give it to Christ, who empowers me to replace it with His truth."
